about: One Codex turn: an inactive Codex session in a scratch folder stands as a stub; sending it a one-word request grows it back to its full column. Run with --var folder=<a scratch folder whose only Codex session is idle> and the page URL's ?cwd= set to it.

actions.note: guard: the scratch floor, with a stub on it

actions.type: Reply with the single word ok
actions.note: typed with the stub focused: its chat opens with it (the bottom bar is gone, 2026-11-13)
